steps: Assess housing for familystr monitoring & evaluation using affordability ratio and supply-demand analysis
Design housing program with social housing, inclusionary zoning, and subsidies
Implement through public-private partnerships and land use reform
Deploy housing quality standards with inspection and enforcement
Measure through affordability ratios, homelessness rates, and housing quality
treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — housing affordability ratio using housing cost survey. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — housing affordability ratio measured annually. Target: housing cost <30% income. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against UN-Habitat housing indicator. Target: 50% of goal. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation — housing affordability ratio trending toward cost <25%. Escalate if <cost <40% ceiling. ANNUAL REVIEW: Comprehensive audit using UN-Habitat housing framework. Report to Housing Director.
treatments.escalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 180 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >30 consecutive days, escalate to a epidemiology and mortality analysis specialist for root cause analysis and intervention redesign. If the intervention produces adverse unintended effects at any point, pause implementation and request specialist review within 30 days.
